stories.title: Starbucks opens new store at New Friends Colony Community Centre
stories.body:
Tata Starbucks has opened a new Starbucks store at the New Friends Colony (NFC) Community Centre, New Delhi, according to a LinkedIn post by Bhupendra Negi, the company's Regional Operation Manager. The store is on the first floor, above Pebble Street.

The store is listed as open from 8 am to 11 pm every day. The company says its aim is to create a "Third Place", a welcoming space where customers can connect and recharge, and to become part of the local community.
